items.author: SK하이닉스
items.highlights: SK하이닉스는 2026년 3분기 매출 104.6조, 영업이익 83.3조로 분기 최대 실적을 내며 매출 100조를 처음 돌파했다. HBM4 · 서버용 DDR5 등 고부가 메모리 판매 확대와 장기공급계약으로 2030년까지 이어질 공급 부족에 대응하고, 약 100조 규모의 주주환원도 추진한다. PRESS SK하이닉스, 2026년 3분기 경영실적 발표 ▪ 매출 104조 6,155억 원, 영업이익 83조 3,338억 원, 순이익 39조 7,756억 원… 분기 매출 사상 첫 100조 원 돌파 ▪ 곽노정 CEO, 솔리다임 IPO 검토 중단 배경 및 주주환원 직접 설명 ▪ HBM4 · 서버용 고부가 제품 판매 확대… 4분기부터 HBM4가 주력 제품으로 자리매김 ▪ 2027~2028년 생산능력의 50% 이상 장기공급계약 확보… 시장 상황 반영 구조로 안정적 수익성 확보 ▪ 올해 약 100조 원 규모 주주환원 실행… 키옥시아 투자 수익 대부분 주주와 공유 ... SK하이닉스가 올해 3분기 매출액 104조 6,155억 원, 영업이익 83조 3,338억 원(영업이익률 80%), 순이익 39조 7,756억 원(순이익률 38%)을 기록했다고 28일 밝혔다. (K-IFRS 기준) .

items.title: SK Hynix Q3 profit jumps sevenfold to record high, Nvidia supplier unveils $75 billion shareholder return plan
items.author: Reuters
items.highlights: SK Hynix Q3 profit jumps sevenfold to a record as AI chip demand surges. Nvidia supplier announces $75.4 billion shareholder return plan. South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix reported a more than seven-fold rise in quarterly operating profit to a record high on Wednesday, beating market forecasts, as continued demand for AI infrastructure drove up memory chip prices. items.title: SK hynix says DRAM, HBM booked through 2029 as profit soars to $62B
items.author: LEE JAE-LIM
items.highlights: SK hynix’s operating profit surged more than sevenfold on year to a record 83.33 trillion won ($62.23 billion) in the third quarter, helping settle fears of an AI investment bubble and a looming memory chip glut as the chipmaker said its dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) and high bandwidth memory (HBM) volumes are effectively sold out through 2029. The blowout earnings sent Korean chip stocks soaring Wednesday, lifting the Kospi by 6.63 percent to close at 6,012.44 points — its biggest single-day gain since July 31. items.highlights: 智通财经APP获悉，SK海力士(SKHY.US)公布了2026年第三季度业绩，并举行了业绩电话会议。 SK 海力士第三季度营收 104.6 万亿韩元，环比增长 32%、同比增长 328%，史上首次单季突破 100 万亿韩元;营业利润 83.3 万亿韩元，环比增 38%、同比增 632%，营业利润率环比再升 3 个百分点至 80%，营业利润与利润率双双刷新季度纪录。分产品看，DRAM 位出货量环比增约 10%，其中 HBM4 三季度启动全面量产与出货、服务器 DDR5 出货环比增逾 40%，DRAM 均价环比涨至 20% 高位段;NAND 位出货因结构调整环比略降，但均价环比涨至 20% 中段。值得留意的是净利润环比下降 58% 至 39.8 万亿韩元——管理层明确归因于非经营性项目：汇兑相关净损失 11.6 万亿、投资资产估值损失 22.9 万亿，合计非经营性净支出 32.6 万亿韩元，与经营层面无关。展望上，公司预计 2027 年全球 CSP 资本开支增长逾 60%、已锁定电力容量同比增长逾 100%，全球 AI 数据中心基础设施市场到 2030 年保持约 40% 的年增速;但受供给能力约束，2027 年可实现的需求增长与今年相近，DRAM 为 20% 中段、NAND 为十几个百分点高段位。四季度指引为 DRAM 位出货环比增 20% 中段、NAND 增个位数中段。资本开支方面

items.title: Nvidia's Record Results Lift Profit Outlook for Samsung, SK hynix - Seoul Economic Daily
items.author: Suh Jong-gap, Cho Yang-joon, Lee Seok-jin
items.highlights: Nvidia posted another record quarter as the leader in artificial intelligence chips, prompting analysts to raise their earnings expectations for Samsung Electronics and SK hynix. Expanding investment in AI data centers and a prolonged shortage of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) are expected to sustain profit gains at the South Korean memory makers for some time. Nvidia said on the 26th that revenue reached $96.22 billion, or about 133.2 trillion won, in the second quarter of fiscal 2027, covering May through July 2026, with operating profit of $63.734 billion, or about 88.34 trillion won.
